dispositions.reason: The direct first-party evidence describes LRLR as indicating explosive moves, but it does not establish a direction, involvement/entry action, target, hold/fail rule, or setup transition. The move-character description is therefore insufficient to admit a predicate candidate without inventing semantics.

The direct first-party evidence defines Tape Reading as studying real-time price delivery for experience while holding no interest in pushing an entry. It is therefore treated as an observational practice, not an executable predicate candidate.
